meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 通道：复制适配器、注册通道、安装固定版本依赖并构建验证；配置令牌与投递方式后重启，即可收发 Slack 消息。
howto.when: 在配置 NanoClaw 时，当用户要求接入 Slack 通道，或配置流程走到通道添加环节时使用。

say.text: 帮我添加 Slack 通道
say.note: 启动 add-slack 流程，开始复制并注册适配器。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 配置 Slack
say.note: 选择无需公网 URL 的本地连接方式。

say.text: 把 Slack 接到我的私信
say.note: 引导你提供成员 ID 以解析 DM 频道。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack support to NanoClaw: copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers it, pins the dependency, builds, validates; after configuring credentials and event delivery and restarting, the service can send/receive Slack messages.
howto.when_en: Used during NanoClaw setup when the user asks to add Slack channel integration, or when the config flow reaches the channel-add step.

say_en.note: Starts the add-slack flow to copy and register the adapter.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with Socket Mode
say_en.note: Chooses the local connection without a public URL.
Prompts for your member ID to resolve the DM channel.
